end.summary:
Discussed observing leaf shapes and bird features such as beaks and feet.
Practised linking hooked beaks with catching small animals.
Linked webbed feet with swimming and a duck’s beak with catching fish from water.
Duck beak description was corrected from long and sharp to flat, spoon-like; teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised observing features and connecting them to how birds eat or move. Atharv used observation to link a hooked beak with catching small animals and webbed feet with swimming. At home, look at one bird or leaf together and ask Atharv to name one feature and explain how it helps.
